question: Is the In-N-Out Burger a safe bet to eat at right now? Show detailed visual analytics to answer this.
output_text: Yes, In-N-Out Burger is a safe bet to eat at in Salt Lake County. Visual analytics across all Salt Lake County Health Department (SLCHD) locations reveal consistently low inspection scores, stable compliance over time, and excellent customer ratings. Across 11 locations in Utah, customer ratings range from 4.5 to 4.6 out of 5 stars based on thousands of reviews (e.g., 4,588 reviews in West Valley City and 6,241 reviews in Centerville). For the 5 locations with matched SLCHD inspection history, most recent inspection scores remain in the low-risk range (ranging from 2 to 8, where 0 is clean and lower is better): West Valley City scored 2 (Feb 2026) with zero critical violations; West Jordan scored 4 (Mar 2026) with zero critical violations; Midvale scored 5 (Jan 2026) with 1 critical item (hand drying provision); Draper scored 8 (Jun 2026) with 1 critical item (cold holding tomatoes at 46°F); and Riverton scored 8 (Apr 2026) with 1 critical item (dirty ice bin interior). Historical annual averages across all SLCHD locations have stayed steady between 3.0 and 6.2 from 2019 to 2026. Non-critical equipment air-drying (18 citations) and physical floor repair (13 citations) account for the majority of historical line-item citations.

tool_args.query:
SELECT 
    ek.slchd_establishment_key,
    ek.name,
    ek.address,
    ek.city,
    i.inspection_id,
    i.inspection_date,
    it.description as inspection_type,
    i.inspection_score,
    COUNT(v.violation_id) as total_violations_cited,
    SUM(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as critical_violations
FROM establishment_keys ek
JOIN inspections i ON ek.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
LEFT JOIN inspection_types it ON i.inspection_type_id = it.inspection_type_id
LEFT JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
WHERE ek.name LIKE '%IN%OUT%' OR ek.name LIKE '%In-N-Out%'
GROUP BY ek.slchd_establishment_key, ek.name, ek.address, ek.city, i.inspection_id, i.inspection_date, it.description, i.inspection_score
ORDER BY ek.city, i.inspection_date DESC;

args.query:
SELECT 
    ek.slchd_establishment_key,
    ek.name,
    ek.address,
    ek.city,
    i.inspection_id,
    i.inspection_date,
    it.description as inspection_type,
    i.inspection_score,
    COUNT(v.violation_id) as total_violations_cited,
    SUM(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as critical_violations
FROM establishment_keys ek
JOIN inspections i ON ek.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
LEFT JOIN inspection_types it ON i.inspection_type_id = it.inspection_type_id
LEFT JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
WHERE ek.name LIKE '%IN%OUT%' OR ek.name LIKE '%In-N-Out%'
GROUP BY ek.slchd_establishment_key, ek.name, ek.address, ek.city, i.inspection_id, i.inspection_date, it.description, i.inspection_score
ORDER BY ek.city, i.inspection_date DESC;

args.query:
SELECT 
    ek.slchd_establishment_key,
    ek.name,
    ek.address,
    ek.city,
    i.inspection_id,
    i.inspection_date,
    it.description as inspection_type,
    i.inspection_score,
    COUNT(v.violation_id) as total_violations_cited,
    SUM(CASE WHEN vc.critical THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as critical_violations
FROM establishment_keys ek
JOIN inspections i ON ek.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
LEFT JOIN inspection_types it ON i.inspection_type_id = it.inspection_type_id
LEFT JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
WHERE ek.name = 'IN N OUT BURGER'
GROUP BY ek.slchd_establishment_key, ek.name, ek.address, ek.city, i.inspection_id, i.inspection_date, it.description, i.inspection_score
ORDER BY ek.city, i.inspection_date DESC;
